name: dc-el_alamein-coop-rec
description: Desert Combat El Alamein co-op with the server-side recorder preloaded, bots only. DC's overlay of the vanilla level (vanilla's AI data, DC's SinglePlayer layer): helicopters (Mi-24, Mi-8, AH-64, UH-60L), jets (MiG-29, Su-25, Mirage, F-14B, F-15C, A-10C), T-72/M1A1, BMP-2/M2A3, BRDM-2, Humvee, Lada, DPV, artillery (BM-21, M-1974, MLRS, M-109, Scud) and open bases whose pads change sides. Needs `lab.py setup --mods-from-client DesertCombat`.
human: No client needed: the server records itself. Let the round run to its end (or 20 min), then `lab.py stop`.
